headline: Jeovanny Rodriguez elected City Council President and Ana Levy elected Vice President
summary: The City Council held its first meeting after the 2026 Inauguration Ceremony to elect a Council President and Vice President. Councilor Jeovanny Rodriguez won the Council Presidency over Councilor Marc Laplante, and Councilor Ana Levy won the Vice Presidency over Councilor Gregory Delrosario. The Council also voted to make the Council President's election unanimous.
decisions: Elected Councilor Jeovanny Rodriguez as City Council President by a roll call vote of 5-4 over Councilor Marc Laplante.
Elected Councilor Ana Levy as City Council Vice President by a roll call vote of 5-4 over Councilor Gregory Delrosario.
Approved a motion to make the election of the Council President unanimous, passed unanimously by roll call vote.

MINUTES OF REGULAR MEETING 
OF THE LAWRENCE CITY COUNCIL 
Monday, January 5, 2026 
 
A REGULAR MEETING of the Lawrence City Council was held on Monday, January 5, 2026. 
The meeting was called to Order at approximately 7:40 p.m. by City Clerk, Eileen O’Connor 
Bernal. This public Meeting of the Lawrence City Council was conducted in person at the 
Lawrence High School Auditorium located at 70-71 North Parish Road in Lawrence, immediately 
following the swearing-in of the newly elected City Council and other City Officials at the 2026 
Inauguration Ceremony.  
This public meeting of the Lawrence City Council was conducted in person only. It was broadcast, 
but there was no remote participation. Consistent with the terms established in the City Charter, 
there were only two (2) items of business on the agenda. As it was combined with the 
Inauguration, there was no Moment of Silence, Pledge of Allegiance, Approval of Minutes or 
Public Participation.  
DOC # 01/26  Election of City Council President  
 
Clerk Bernal announced that the first order of business was for the Council to elect a City Council 
President. The Clerk asked if there were any nominees for the position. Councilor Gregory 
Delrosario nom inated Councilor Marc Laplante. That nomination was seconded by Councilor 
Rosaly Gonzalez.  
 
Councilor Ana Levy nominated Councilor Jeovanny Rodriguez. That nomination was seconded 
by Councilor Stephany Infante.  
 
The Clerk asked if there were any other Nominees. No other nominees were named and 
nominations were closed.  
 
A ROLL CALL VOTE for the City Council President occurred as follows:  
 
 Councilor Marc Laplante:  Marc Laplante 
 Councilor Ana Levy:   Jeovanny Rodriguez 
 Councilor Jeovanny Rodriguez: Jeovanny Rodriguez 
 Councilor Gregory Delrosario: Marc Laplante 
Councilor Stephany Infante:  Jeovanny Rodriguez 
 Councilor Celina Reyes:  Marc Laplante 
Councilor Vivian Marmol:  Jeovanny Rodriguez 
 Councilor Franklin Miguel:  Jeovanny Rodriguez 
Councilor Rosaly Gonzalez:  Marc Laplante 
 
The tally was then announced that Councilor Jeovanny Rodriguez had won the Council Presidency 
by a 5 – 4 margin over Councilor Marc Laplante.
DOC # 02/24  Election of City Council Vice President  
 
Clerk Bernal then announced that the second order of business was for the Council to elect a new 
City Council Vice President, and she passed the gavel to the newly elected Council President.  The 
Council President asked if there were any nominees for the position.  
 
Councilor Stephany Infante nominated Councilor Ana Levy for the Vice Presidency. That 
nomination was seconded by Councilor Franklin Miguel.  
 
Councilor Celina Reyes then nominated Councilor Gregory Delrosario for the Vice Presidency, 
and that nomination was seconded by Councilor Laplante.   
 
The Council President then asked if there were any other nominees for the Vice Presidency. No 
other nominees were named and nominations were closed. 
 
A ROLL CALL VOTE for the City Council Vice President occurred as follows:  
 
 Councilor Rosaly Gonzalez:   Gregory Delrosario  
 Councilor Franklin Miguel:  Ana Levy  
 Councilor Vivian Marmol:  Ana Levy 
 Councilor Celina Reyes:  Gregory Delrosario 
 Councilor Stephany Infante:  Ana Levy 
Councilor Gregory Delrosario: Gregory Delrosario  
Councilor Jeovanny Rodriguez: Ana Levy 
Councilor Ana Levy:    Ana Levy 
Councilor Marc Laplante:   Gregory Delrosario 
 
The tally was then announced that Councilor Ana Levy had won the Council Vice Presidency by 
a 5 to 4 margin, over Councilor Gregory Delrosario.  
 
Councilor Marc Laplante then asked to be recognized and requested that his Motion to make the 
election of the Council President “Unanimous” be permitted. His Motion was seconded by 
Councilor Infante and that Motion passed unanimously.  
 
Councilor Marc Laplante:  Jeovanny Rodriguez 
 Councilor Ana Levy:   Jeovanny Rodriguez 
 Councilor Jeovanny Rodriguez: Jeovanny Rodriguez 
 Councilor Gregory Delrosario: Jeovanny Rodriguez 
Councilor Stephany Infante:  Jeovanny Rodriguez 
 Councilor Celina Reyes:  Jeovanny Rodriguez  
Councilor Vivian Marmol:  Jeovanny Rodriguez 
 Councilor Franklin Miguel:  Jeovanny Rodriguez 
Councilor Rosaly Gonzalez:  Jeovanny Rodriguez

The Clerk then asked for a MOTION to ADJOURN. A Motion to Adjourn was made by Councilor 
Infante and was seconded by Councilor Marmol. The Motion passed by a Unanimous Voice Vote.  
 
MEETING ADJOURNED at APPROXIMATELY 8:00 P.M.
